video_title: Norman Powell's First 30 Days With the Chicago Bulls

quotes.speaker: Norman Powell
quotes.summary_phrase: Norman Powell on his leadership role with the Chicago Bulls
quotes.excerpt: The biggest thing that I want this chapter with the Bulls to add to my career is to show that I can be a true leader.
quotes.quote: The biggest thing that I want this chapter with the Bulls to add to my career is to show that I can be a true leader.

quotes.speaker: Norman Powell
quotes.summary_phrase: Norman Powell on leading by example as a new teammate
quotes.excerpt: The biggest way to establish myself as a leader, even though I'm coming into a new team, is to lead by example.
quotes.quote: The biggest way to establish myself as a leader, even though I'm coming into a new team, is to lead by example. Being the first one in early, last one to leave, communicating, talking, not just saying all the right stuff, but doing all the right stuff as well.

quotes.speaker: Norman Powell
quotes.summary_phrase: Norman Powell on his evolving role as a vocal leader
quotes.excerpt: I feel like this is another opportunity to show that I can be a true leader.
quotes.quote: I feel like this is another opportunity to show that I can be a true leader. Not just by leading by example through workouts and things like that, but also being a vocal leader, taking the ownership of where the team is at, good and bad. Being able to take full responsibility and then being able to learn. It's a new role for me in the NBA at least. It's easy to be asked upon to be a guy every single night to go out there and perform and play just because I work so hard, but can I actually, my play also raise the level of my teammates' play as well?
